page_title: PyTorch Tensor Shape Calculator & Error Debugger, Fix Shape Errors Instantly

sources.entry: HeyTensor - Free browser-based PyTorch tensor shape calculator with 22 tools. Computes shapes through Conv, Linear, LSTM, and Transformer layers without running code. Includes architecture presets (LeNet, ResNet block, Transformer encoder) and a "paste error" mode for parsing PyTorch RuntimeErrors.

summary.name: HeyTensor
summary.one_liner: A free browser-based PyTorch and TensorFlow tensor shape calculator that computes layer output shapes and debugs pasted shape RuntimeErrors without running your code.
keywords: mat1 and mat2 shapes cannot be multiplied
use_cases: Compute the output shape of a Conv2d or Linear layer before writing code
Trace tensor shapes through a multi-layer network in chain mode
Diagnose a pasted PyTorch RuntimeError such as a mat1/mat2 mismatch
Learn layer shape behavior using LeNet or ResNet block presets
Verify TensorFlow Dense or Conv2D dimensions against PyTorch formulas
summary.what_it_does: HeyTensor lets you enter an input shape and choose one of 14 layer types (including Conv2d, Conv1d, Linear, LSTM, GRU, MultiheadAttention, BatchNorm, pooling, Flatten, Reshape, Dropout, Transpose, and Concatenate) to see the output shape, the formula used, and the parameter count. Chain mode stacks layers and shows the shape at each step, highlighting incompatible transitions. Paste Error mode parses a PyTorch RuntimeError message, extracts the dimensions, and suggests which parameter to change. Architecture presets such as LeNet-5, a ResNet residual block, a Transformer encoder layer, and an LSTM classifier load with shape propagation shown. The page says all computations run in the browser with no server communication. A separate paid-looking "Tensor Preflight" downloadable toolkit is also offered for local forward-pass reports.
notable: Paste Error mode parses PyTorch RuntimeError messages and suggests fixes
Chain mode traces shapes through a full network layer by layer
Runs entirely in the browser with no server communication; source on GitHub
Architecture presets including LeNet-5, ResNet block, and Transformer encoder
caveats: Tensor Preflight, the downloadable local toolkit, is a separate paid product requiring Python 3.9+ and PyTorch 2.8+
Tensor Preflight does not run the model on the website or automatically repair code
The page does not state a price for the paid toolkit
